name: web
// targets: dev/start ports are set so the storefront (4200) never collides with api-gateway (3000). build pins NODE_ENV=production explicitly: with a stray/non-standard NODE_ENV in the invoking shell (e.g. left over from a Jest run), `next build`'s Turbopack prerenderer crashes every route with 'Cannot read properties of null (reading useContext)' — Next itself warns 'non-standard NODE_ENV'. Setting it here makes the build deterministic regardless of ambient shell state.
